command.name: Dawnsong
verbatim: Rounds 1, 4, 7: Deal Physical Damage to 2 Enemies within adjacency (Damage Rate: +70%).
Rounds 2, 5, 8: Deal Fire Damage to 3 Enemies in any lane (Damage Rate: +20%). This damage is increased by 1.5x if the target is afflicted with a Control effect (Damage Rate: +30%).
At 6+ Stars: Rounds 2, 5, 8: Apply Recovery to 2 other Allies in any lane (Recovery Rate: +120%, enhanced by Intelligence).

vanguard.name: Champion's Vigor
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Recovery Dealt by +15% and Initiative by +25. Increase the Damage Dealt by +8% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Ebbing Fury
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: Reduce Damage Dealt of all Enemies AND Allies for 3 rounds. Start of Round 4: Apply Recovery to 3 Allies in any lane.

habits.name: Sharp Resolve
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Strength and Intelligence until the end of combat.

habits.name: Echoing Melody
habits.verbatim: Dawnsong gains: Rounds 2, 5, 8: Apply Recovery to 2 other Allies in any lane, enhanced by Intelligence.

habits.name: Unbroken Devotion
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat Increase Recovery Received of 2 other Allies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Inspiring Melody
habits.verbatim: Each Round: chance to increase Initiative and grant Resistance to 1 other Ally within adjacency for 3 rounds.
